title: A non-small launch mode replaces the false uniform initial-mixed reset
statement: The final review supersedes the pending-obligations history and accepts the carried-launch construction ONLY with excessive-envelope, connector-mediated-return, stopped same-law Cauchy–Schwarz, phase-factor precision, large-B clock and review Section4 actual-output bad-L completions. Initial D=0 mixed states get a NON-SMALL launch row L; positive-D starts retain their earned reset R. The hidden-clock rates1,10,240 give first holding mean1/251 and nonvanishing connector reward, so no positive n-reset exponent is restored for all initial mixed states. Q_R may exit at a mixed connector; the completed return bound and preconditioned pure-launch Green pay this new L-to-L_bad channel. Fix lambda/full launch envelope, then M, then residual threshold. Bounded-A mixed activation is UP and uses actual positive h_min/B-scaled clock. This drops ONLY the initial mixed population-clock guard; all other raw trace/pool/true-F/activity/weak-reversibility checks and named phase foundations remain binding.
